Design matrix grouped into feature bands

Source: R/design_generics.R, R/design_metadata.R
design_bands.Rd

Collects the event-model design matrix together with the band and sub-band of every column, in the form banded (grouped) regression needs: one matrix and one group label per column. The labels come from design_colmap(), which remains the single source of truth. A feature() term declares them with band and subband; any other term is a band of its own, named by its term tag.

Usage

design_bands(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'event_model'
design_bands(x, terms = NULL, bands = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

The object, typically an event_model.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

terms

Optional character vector of term tags (names(terms(x))); only columns of these terms are returned.

bands

Optional character vector of band names; only columns in these bands are returned. With both terms and bands, a column must satisfy both.

Value

A list with elements:

  • X: numeric design matrix (scans by columns) with column names

  • band: character vector, the band of each column of X

  • subband: character vector, the sub-band of each column; equal to band where no sub-band was declared

  • families: named list with one element for each band that has more than one distinct sub-band, holding the character vector of its sub-bands in column order

  • colmap: the rows of design_colmap() for the columns of X. Its col column still indexes the full design matrix.

See also

design_colmap(), feature()

Examples

dt <- 0.5
t <- seq(0, 39.5, by = dt)
phon <- cbind(stop = abs(sin(t)), nasal = abs(cos(t)), voiced = abs(sin(2 * t)))
des <- data.frame(onset = c(0, 10, 20, 30), run = 1,
                  cond = factor(c("A", "B", "A", "B")))
sframe <- fmrihrf::sampling_frame(blocklens = 40, TR = 1)
emod <- event_model(
  onset ~ hrf(cond) +
    feature(phon, dt = dt, id = "phon", band = "phonological",
            subband = c("manner", "manner", "voicing")),
  data = des, block = ~run, sampling_frame = sframe
)
b <- design_bands(emod)
table(b$band, b$subband)
#>               
#>                cond manner voicing
#>   cond            2      0       0
#>   phonological    0      2       1
b$families
#> $phonological
#> [1] "manner"  "voicing"
#> 

# Only the phonological band
colnames(design_bands(emod, bands = "phonological")$X)
#> [1] "phon_stop"   "phon_nasal"  "phon_voiced"
